handlers.command: bash -c 'out=$(jq -r "(.tool_response // .tool_output // empty) | tostring" 2>/dev/null); if grep -qiE "Access[ -]?Denied|Permission denied|not authorized to perform|Unauthorized|Forbidden|ThrottlingException|Throttled|TooManyRequests|SlowDown|LimitExceeded|AuthFailure|SignatureDoesNotMatch|ExpiredToken|Validation(Error|Exception)|NotFound|ServiceUnavailable|InternalServer|FailureReason|An error occurred" <<<"$out"; then jq -n --arg m "AWS error pattern detected in output. Consider capturing for incident context." "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PostToolUse\",additionalContext:\$m}}"; fi'
echo 'AWS Ops Plugin loaded. Domains: EKS, Network, IAM, Observability, Storage, Database, Analytics, Cost, Well-Architected.'
